paragraphs.text: # dsh-chat-plus: Chat plus
`dsh-chat-plus` adds WorkBuddy-style in-session reply regeneration with version switching to DeepSee
k Harness, plus message editing, rollback, soft deletion, and a session recycle bin.
## Features
### Reply versions

- Regenerate the latest turn without creating a new session.
- Keep multiple replies in the same con

versation and switch with `< 1/2 >` or the left/right arrow keys.
- Show the model and generation ti

me for the active version.
- Continue the conversation from the selected version.
- Warn when regene
ration may execute tools again, without blocking the action.
### Message actions

- Edit, roll back, copy, or delete a user question from its action row.
- Edit any turn; later turns

are soft-deleted and original attachments can be retained.
- Roll back from a node and put the orig

inal question back into the composer.
- Delete one reply with its reasoning and tool calls, or delet

e a complete question/reply turn.
- Select multiple messages and delete them in one operation.
### Session recycle bin

- Add Delete session after Archive session in the session menu.
- Stop active work before moving a s

ession to the recycle bin.
- Open the recycle bin from the bottom of the workspace sidebar.
- Restor

e, permanently delete one session, or empty the bin.
- Cascade operations to child subagent sessions

, permanently delete one session, or empty the bin.
- Cascade operations to child subagent sessions.
## Important boundaries
- Message deletion is soft deletion: the content leaves the model context and chat view, while the a

ppend-only raw log remains unchanged.
- Switching versions appends the selected version back into th

e log, so the log can grow; the result remains readable after a cold restart.
- Regeneration may exe

cute tools again. External side effects are not automatically undone.
- Permanent recycle-bin deleti
on is irreversible and removes session logs, projection cache entries, and associated child sessions
